propositions: LLM model output extraction from free text remains heuristic without an explicit output channel, allowing trailing schema-valid decoys and fence-wrapped quoted JSON to interfere with correct payload extraction.

Extraction must honor a deterministic marker-block priority: when complete `<<<REBAR_OUTPUT>>>`...`<<<END>>>` marker blocks are present, iterate blocks in reverse document order and return the first block whose content validates; if no block validates, raise the last block's error (fail-closed), not falling back to full-reply selection.
Marker recognition is line-anchored (markers recognized only when alone on their own line) to prevent content/marker collision when a JSON string value contains the literal marker text.

Bounded-retry failure recovery (layer 4) must name the same markers in its retry instruction to keep the fail-closed channel consistent across both attempt rounds, not reverting to bare-JSON instructions that omit the sentinels.
Marker-block extraction and directive are single-sourced from one module constant to prevent drift between what the model is instructed to emit and what the parser looks for.
Replies with no complete marker blocks fall back to schema-filtered full-reply selection byte-for-byte identically to the prior implementation, ensuring markerless/legacy transcripts do not regress.
